slices.behaviour: A pull-request-only CI mutation job computes the packages/core/src files changed against the PR base (widening to all of src when a Stryker or vitest config changes, skipping when nothing in src changed) and runs Stryker incrementally on them. Measured on this ticket's own pull request 44 by check 48, which reads the job timings from the GitHub API: run 37068194534 on 7682adc, cold with no incremental cache, mutated all of src because a Stryker config changed (1 file, 5 mutants, 3 killed, 2 compile errors) in a 32-second job; run 37070105397 on ca030d9, warm from the incremental cache, in a 29-second job. Both well under the ten-minute bound of criterion 4, settled as the clarify decision said it would be: by the measured duration of the CI step on this ticket's own pull request. src holds one mutable file today, so the figure says the step is fast on today's src, not on a src fifty times larger.
